summary: Samantha Voix waiting cues (Amine 31/10, « go pour tout »): the run status now carries progress.activity, the latest typed Samantha tool the brain run started (name and action only), so the app says one useful phrase per turn after 1.5 s (« Je regarde tes factures. »), then at most a soft earcon; the 30 s budget notice becomes « Je te donne la réponse dès que je l'ai. ».
reason: S24 voice bench 31/10: generic local waiting clips relaunched every 5-10 s while the brain works (waiting_local, relaunch_local), then « Je cherche encore, … » beyond 30 s; Amine finds the repetition annoying and decided the target behaviour.

routes.change: optional progress.activity {tool, action?, at?} (latest typed samantha_* tool started by the run)
routes.budget: unchanged; no Gateway read for an observed run

routes.change: pending brain notice text: « Je te donne la réponse dès que je l'ai. »

fixtures.provenance: Existing S24 captures reused (typed tool calls with actions, 30/10 brain run tool sequence, compiled typed tool names); no new capture (no S24 access for this lot).

capabilities.reason: No capability added or changed: a read-only status field and a notice text. Payment and deterministic routes are unchanged.

architecture.reason: Existing owners only: the Gateway run observer and the run status projection carry the activity; the app's existing local clip owner says the phrase; VoiceTurnProtocol keeps the notice exactly once. No new store, router, scheduler, queue or retry.

app_impact.detail: The paired APK reads progress.activity and replaces the repeated waiting clips with one phrase, earcons and the setting; without it the deployed app keeps its clips and hears the new notice wording.

evidence: Run status field and voice notice only; no MCP tool, schema or adapter change.

limitations: On the S24 the brain session starts 10-22 s after acceptance, so at 1.5 s the typed tool is rarely known yet: the phrase will mostly be the generic one until the brain gets faster.

The typed tool stream frame (data.name, data.args.action) follows the shape the observer already reads; to confirm on the S24 at the recette (logcat waiting_cue phrase=… source=…). Tool Search's wrapped tool_call is not read.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the Companion with companion-deploy.sh; the new app falls back to the generic phrase and the old notice.
